response.overview: Making Mistress More documents the rise of a new dominatrix--from house slave to Head Mistress--at La Domaine Esemar, a BDSM chateau in upstate New York. As a house slave, More learned the skills of submission from Master R. With this foundation, Master R asked her to take over the chateau as Head Mistress. We watch her learn the trade of being a professional sex worker. As Mistress More narrates her experiences, we learn about the world of BDSM fetishes from eccentric characters: Shine and his love of the bullwhip, J-Man a client with spinal bifida, and Ninja Mike and his love of crucifixion. As each character explains their draw to the world of BDSM, we gain an insight into this underground world.
